description: Checks Japanese advertising sentences for cosmetics, health foods or hair-growth products and scores how strongly each sentence reads as asserting a bodily effect (a common issue under Japan's Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act / 薬機法). Returns a score per sentence (0-100%) and links to rephrasing examples. Up to 5 sentences per call, 3 calls per day per user. Not legal advice.
name: check_ad_expression
